owner_approval.scope: Supersedes the unmerged separation proposal: retain selected report data and its necessary approved raw envelopes/proof metadata together for three years; mandatory scoped erasure across layers. Cost discussion deferred by owner. Decision/compatibility record only in this PR.
owner_approval.latest_decision: Codex bence senkron tutalım, ayırma başlı başına bir karmaşa getirecek. Veri maliyetleri Supabase üst sınırlar zaten bunlar şu veritabanı isi bitsin konuşmak istediğim şeyler.

normal_report_retention.applies_to: Selected necessary report fields and original approved raw envelopes, source receipts/proof metadata and identity/FX/version dependencies required by those reports.

field_selection.report_values: Necessary approved measurements at their approved native grain; exact units/decimals/support/observation/completeness preserved.
field_selection.historical_context: Only necessary owner/account/product/channel identity, original business date/timezone/source currency and actual applied FX/projection/formula/version and minimum immutable proof summary.
field_selection.individual_records: Existing necessary order/event identities and approved raw projection fields follow the linked source policy only when required for the accepted report/native grain and erasure scope; being inside a Dataset does not approve arbitrary extra fields.

mandatory_erasure.installation: All in-scope merchant data layers including historical report/provenance/mapping; no blanket retention exemption for reports.
mandatory_erasure.customer: Relevant report rows must remain addressable after normal raw expiry; no success when scope is unknown.

normal_cleanup.expiration_order: Expire/delete eligible report rows first; remove source/proof/mapping dependencies only when no retained dependent record remains and existing consumer/partial/unknown gates allow.

implementation_acceptance: One versioned calendar-year policy yields the report expiry and protects every necessary linked raw page/batch/receipt/identity dependency through that expiry.
Current source foreign keys, live source receipt/page readback and evidence pins remain in place; no independent historical-proof archive or source separation.
Linked reporting sources/proof metadata use the accepted three-year class; unlinked 90/365 defaults remain and are not accidentally applied to linked rows.
Exact approved raw projection fields, original native fact grain, decimal accuracy, source completeness and existing role/mapping/FX proof gates remain.
Calendar boundary, timezone/leap-day, original data date and replay/correction non-extension checks pass.
Expired normal report data is removed before its now-unneeded evidence; other retained dependents and existing consumer/partial/unknown guards block premature cleanup.
Mandatory installation/customer erasure still removes in-scope linked report/source/identity layers before normal expiry; unrelated merchants preserved.

supersedes_unmerged_proposal.proposal: Independent report lifetime and source/report separation
supersedes_unmerged_proposal.owner_changed_to: Synchronized retention; keep existing evidence dependencies.
